hook: Nothing announces Ear, earbuds with a built-in AI notetaker, launching
hookText: Nothing announces Ear, earbuds with a built-in AI notetaker, launching

beats.say: Nothing's first step in its AI hardware plans is Ear, in-ear headphones that record meetings and calls and produce transcripts, summaries, pre-meeting briefs and next steps.
Nothing calls it its best in-ear audio to date and says the earbuds will brief you on important items before the next morning's meetings.
The teaser drew about 900K views ahead of the December 8 launch.
